what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Jordan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8900 Iraqi refugees in Jordan, 3.3% of all refugees from Iraq.
Today Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Iraq from 1985 to 1988, and armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Iraq with the PUK and KDP from 1985 to 1992.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in every year from 2004 to 2025, at war level in many of them.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 15 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 500000, at the end of 2006 to 2008, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2006 to 2011.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Jordan.
These are year-end totals for Jordan only, reported to UNHCR.
